about.subtitle: Get to know me a little better
about.personal.p: Hello! My name is Celia and this is my personal website. After finishing my Software Engineering Degree, I am studying the Master's Degree in Web Engineering at the University of Oviedo. I live in Gijón, Asturias, with my parents, brother and my two dogs.
about.personal.p2: In my free time I enjoy exploring animated films, manga, and botany, listening to folk metal and Japanese music, or looking back on the trips and cultural exchanges I have taken part in.
about.pro.p1: Although I am mainly interested in web development, both frontend and backend, I would like to try different work areas.
about.pro.socialText: You can also check out my code profile on
about.education.caption: University trajectory and degrees pursued
about.education.row1.desc: Modern web architectures, usability and accessibility, XML processing, databases, and full-stack development.
about.education.row2.desc: Software design and architecture, data structures, relational databases, requirements engineering, and agile methodologies.
about.skills.caption: Summary of technological areas, tools, and applied projects
about.skills.row1.proj: Accessible and internationalized personal website (WCAG); marketplace interface with modular validation.
about.skills.row2.proj: Java recommendation module; XLIFF 1.2 structural validation compiled to WebAssembly; REST API for product management.
about.skills.row3.proj: Programmatic HTML generator from XML schemas; database failure recovery and automated cloud deployment.
hobbies.meta.title: Hobbies | My Personal Website
hobbies.coraline.p: One of my favorite animated movies is "Coraline". It's a dark fantasy, horror, and mystery film. In my opinion, it is yet another example that animation can be enjoyed by all audiences.
hobbies.coraline.videoCap: Official trailer for the movie Coraline
hobbies.wha.p: Another of my hobbies is reading Japanese books and mangas (an interest in Japanese culture also reflected in my musical tastes). One of my current favorite series is the manga Witch Hat Atelier, a fantasy story following Coco, a girl who discovers a secret about magic that changes her world. In addition to having a very interesting plot, the author's drawings alone are reason enough to follow the story. Recently, it received an animated adaptation.
hobbies.wha.videoCap: Animated preview of the Witch Hat Atelier series
hobbies.animals.p: I really like animals, and I like spending time with my two dogs, Otto and Orión. Although I would also like to adopt a cat, I don't think my dogs would tolerate it very well.
hobbies.botany.p: One of the hobbies I share with my mother is an interest in plants, a fondness for natural environments that I also enjoy during my trips to places like Lake Sanabria. Because of this, every year we visit the Gijón Botanical Garden several times, trying to go in different seasons to observe the changes in each one.
hobbies.botany.cap: Photos taken during different visits to the Gijón Botanical Garden
travels.meta.title: My travels | My Personal Website
travels.header.p: Some of my most memorable trips
travels.trip1.title: Sanabria
travels.trip1.desc: One of the places I have gone on vacation the most is Vigo de Sanabria, since my uncle has a house near the lake. Its natural landscapes and mountain trails provide an ideal setting for anyone who enjoys nature and botany.
travels.trip2.title: Germany
travels.trip2.desc1: During high school I participated in a German exchange program. Thanks to this, I had the opportunity to visit a town near Munich.
travels.trip2.desc2: Among many of the places we visited is Neuschwanstein Castle, which inspired Disney's castle.
travels.trip3.title: United States
travels.trip3.desc1: In high school I also had the opportunity to participate in the English exchange program, in this case with a high school in Chicago.
travels.trip3.desc2: Although I couldn't attend all activities because I was sick for a few days, I quite enjoyed the experience.
music.meta.title: My music | My Personal Website
music.header.p: Some of my favorite bands and songs
music.saurom.p: Saurom is a Spanish folk metal band that I discovered through a friend. One of my favorite songs by them is "No Seré Yo".
music.binary.p1: The Binary is a Japanese J-pop and J-Rock band, a style that fits right in with my fondness for manga and Japanese culture. It originally featured two vocalists, mido and Akamaru, but the latter left the group in 2024. Currently, mido continues composing and releasing solo songs under the name The Binary.
music.binary.p2: One of my favorite songs by the band is Kienai (消えない), the last song they both participated in.
help.meta.title: Help | My Personal Website
help.header.p: Guidance on how to navigate the website and frequently asked questions
help.navGuide.dd1: You can use the navigation bar to browse between the different sections of the site. The current page is highlighted.
help.navGuide.dd2: At the bottom of each page you have direct access to all sections and the contact email.
help.navGuide.dd3: In the hobbies and music sections you can play, pause, or adjust the volume of videos and audio tracks using the browser's native controls.
help.faq.q1: How can I know which section of the site I am currently on?
help.faq.a1: The active page link is highlighted with a white background in the top bar and appears as the last element in the breadcrumbs.
help.faq.q2: How can I contact the author?
help.faq.a2.part2: from the footer or from the section
help.faq.q3: What should I do if a video or audio doesn't start playing automatically?
help.faq.a3: For accessibility and data savings, multimedia files do not play automatically. Click the play button on each player's controls.
